title: Foresthill Bridge
scope: Full Foresthill Road canyon crossing with a green variable-depth cantilever deck truss, two tapered concrete piers, separated carriageways, sidewalk ledges, rail screens and canyon abutments.
heightPolicy: The model uses a 231.4 m datum at the lower pier footing. Deck elevations rise from about 386.48 m on the west side to 393.18 m on the east. Foundations extend below the sampled canyon terrain.
limitations: The OSM outline and divided roadway establish the frame. Truss panel proportions, pier taper and cross-braces follow ordinary exterior photos.
The roadway and pier footing elevations fit the standard Terrarium grid. Visible pier stations and end structures are geometric approximations.
